name: The LISABO along the room's depth, its long side to the kitchen, 33.6in on both chair sides (staged until Andrew said flip it, 2026-10-26)
notes:
Alternative since the evening of 2026-10-26 (Andrew: "flip it"): the LISABO along the room's depth, the staged room until then; a now has it across. No junior chair (Andrew: Maddie, almost 5, sits on a regular chair).
Staged earlier that evening on Andrew's word: "the dining table right now is pretty shitty, and IMO too small"; "I want a LARGER table, but only get 4 chairs. i.e. we can add more chairs next time, but I like working off dining table / kid can play there too at times too." He linked the LISABO set with six chairs. Here the LISABO 78 3/4 x 30 3/4" ash table with four LISABO ash/Tallmyra chairs and Maddie's URBAN junior chair as a fifth seat, the pendant over it, the BESTÅ buffet (drawn, not ordered: he will see the storage units in person Saturday) and the BLODFLÄDER on the bottom wall. Rugless (F-66): no rug fits under a 78 3/4" table here with the two walkways clear (it would need about 127" of floor), and the wood floor shows under it (Andrew, 2026-10-26: "kitchen on tile, dining on wood"; the sketch had marked this room tile). 11 placed, 4 extras. The room as it was, the VIHALS set with the LYDERSHOLM, is e; the LISABO in black is f, and three extendable tables are g (TARSELE), h (SKANSNÄS) and i (TONSTAD).
The room: 128 x 119, its left side open to the kitchen and its top side to the living room, each with a 30" walkway kept clear (F-42), so the table group has 98 x 89 of floor and two real walls, the right and the bottom. Along the room's depth the 78 3/4" table fits: its living-room end on that walkway's edge, its other end 10 1/4" from the bottom wall under the floating buffet's face, and 33.6" from each long side to the kitchen walkway's edge and to the right wall (tight:33.6: F-36 wants 36", and a chair needs about 30" to sit and push back; nobody passes behind the wall side, and the kitchen side's passing happens in the walkway). Across the room it would leave 29" on both chair sides, so it stands along.
table-1 LISABO 78 3/4 x 30 3/4 x 29 1/8" ash veneer (floor): rot 90, x 63.625-94.375, y 30-108.75. chair-1, chair-2 LISABO ash/Tallmyra white/black, 18 1/8 x 20 1/8" (floor): the wall side, rot 90, x 95.375-115.5, y 40.9-59.1 and 79.9-98.1, 1" off the table, 12.5" behind them to the right wall. chair-3, chair-4 (floor): the kitchen side, rot 270, x 42.5-62.625, y 38.9-57.1 and 81.9-100.1, 12.5" behind them to the walkway's edge. Maddie sits on a regular chair (Andrew, 2026-10-26). Six seats fit along the sides when more chairs come.
pendant-1 GULLSUDARE on the HAVSRIS swag cord (top), x 70.1-87.9, y 60.5-78.25, hooked over the table's center (79, 69.4), its bottom about 30" above the top; the ceiling box is unknown, so the cord runs along the ceiling to the right or bottom wall and down in a cover, never across an open side.
storage-1 BESTÅ wall-mounted cabinet, 70 7/8 x 8 5/8" (top): floated as a buffet on the bottom wall, x 36.7-107.6, underside about 33" up: the table's end stands 1 5/8" short of its face and below it, so its middle doors open over the table's end and it is reached from its ends; drawn, not ordered (Andrew, 2026-10-26: the storage units in person Saturday). art-1 BLODFLÄDER (top) centered above it; lamp-1, lamp-2 VARPTROSS (top) over the buffet's ends, cords in covers; plant-1 FEJKA bird of paradise (floor) in the bottom-right corner, x 117-126, y 108-117, clear of the wall-side chairs.
Color (the video and Andrew's word, 2026-10-26): the living room's honey-oak floor runs through here, the kitchen's cream tile starts at the kitchen line with maple cabinets and beige counters beyond it, oak trim everywhere, with its dark gray sofa, walnut UGGLERUM and birch POÄNG. The ash LISABO is the light note between them, in the same tapered-leg mid-century language as the UGGLERUM and the POÄNG; pale ash on honey oak beside maple is lighter than the floor and low in contrast, so the chairs' gray Tallmyra seats (the sofa's gray) and the dark BLODFLÄDER carry it. For a darker table the same LISABO comes in black (f), and the SKANSNÄS in brown beech (h) is the walnut tone of the UGGLERUM.
Extras: HAVSRIS cord set x1, SVARTSENAP runner x1 and placemats x5 (one per seat), BLANDA MATT bowl x1; the MALINDA chair pads are out (the LISABO seats are upholstered). Felt pads under the chairs' legs on the wood floor (IKEA's FIXA, not in the catalog).
Not placed: the VIHALS table and chairs (e); the LYDERSHOLM (no rug fits, F-66); the ROSENTORP, ÅLHULT and the 55 1/8" LISABO (smaller than he wants).
Total $1,443.88: placed $1,384.94 + extras $58.94; prices as of 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-26 (those before today price-stale, F-02).
Flags across the layout: tight:33.6 (both chair sides, F-36). Delivery: the ash table is not stocked at Long Island (an online order; two flat packages, the top 80 1/4 x 32 1/4 x 2 1/4" at 53 lb 13 oz); the chairs are in stock there.
